title: Dolphins restructured RB De'Von Achane, C Aaron Brewer deals to create cap space

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dolphins restructured RB De'Von Achane, C Aaron Brewer deals to create cap space
sources.description: For those who believe the Dolphins are tanking in 2026, one trend contradicts that conclusion: They're kicking as much cap space as they can into future years.
